ownerRulings_2026_06_16.placement_home: DOUBLE MAPPING: improvement/feature/bonus first ENABLE all allowed builds, then `requires` reigns in to actual allowed. The IMPROVEMENT carries its own placement requires.build (plot predicates) because EVENTS place improvements directly (no hard build link) and must be gated too; BuildInfo ALSO gates its action path (#23). Both gate, deliberately — not redundant, two placement paths (build action vs direct event).
ownerRulings_2026_06_16.plot_predicates: INTRODUCE (parameter-free -> bare per enabler-spec 3): HAS_IRRIGATION, IS_FLATLANDS, IS_HILLS, IS_PEAK, IS_FRESHWATER; HAS_BONUS:{BONUS_X} parameterized -> object. Plot self-reports; the terrain/plot system's predicate surface.

ownerRulings_2026_06_16.unwired_flags: bExtraterresial -> identity (spacemap, leave for now). bPlaces{Bonus,Feature,Terrain} -> identity (a 'random spawn' mechanic, e.g. apple bonus under a lumberjack; LEAVE for now, the mechanic needs its OWN pass, OUT OF SCOPE for #428 - FLAG). bIsUniversalTradeBonusProvider -> identity LIVE CAPABILITY (NOT unwired): consumed via isImprovementBonusTrade(-1) OR-fold (CvImprovementInfo.cpp:313/315), read across trade logic (CvCityAI/CvDLLWidgetData/CvGameInterface). Owner-flagged lynchpin; workflow missed it (grepped only the direct getter).
ownerRulings_2026_06_16.irrigation: THREE-PART (owner 2026-06-16): (1) bRequiresIrrigation -> requires.build.all HAS_IRRIGATION (=isIrrigationAvailable: freshwater OR adjacent irrigated; the 'check' is easy/live). (2) bCarriesIrrigation -> identity.carriesIrrigation:true, MUST be KEPT (the improvement must not lose its ability to carry irrigation; actual propagation is live code updateIrrigated). Carriers: ORCHARD/PLANTATION/VERTICAL_FARM/FARM/GROUNDWATER_WELL. (3) Carrying is TECH-GATED at TEAM level, NOT on the improvement: isPotentialIrrigation() requires CvTeam::isIrrigation(), unlocked by TECH_CANAL_SYSTEMS <bIrrigation> (already captured curate_tech bIrrigation->irrigation team-enabler). Engine ANDs improvement.carriesIrrigation with team.isIrrigation at runtime; the improvement authors NO tech clause for carrying.
ownerRulings_2026_06_16.placement_gate_scope_INVARIANT: requires.build gates ONLY: worker BUILD + canHaveImprovement-checked paths (worker-build UI CvDLLButtonPopup, AI plot-eval CvCity:1814, map-gen CvMapGenerator:147, advanced-start CvPlayer:17703, upgrade CvPlot:875, pedia) AND generic EVENT improvement-placement (route events through canHaveImprovement so an event can't place a disallowed improvement = the owner 'double mapping'). The engine's SANCTIONED OUTCOME placements stay PRIVILEGED direct setImprovementType and MUST remain ungated: raze->IMPROVEMENT_CITY_RUINS (CvCity.cpp:1144), found->IMPROVEMENT_CITY. setImprovementType() does NOT re-validate (verified) so today this is safe; the *may*-break is ONLY if #430 routes the raze/found path through requires.build. IMPROVEMENT_CITY's TECH_DUMMY correctly makes it never worker-buildable (no break: cities are engine-placed, not built); IMPROVEMENT_CITY_RUINS has no PrereqTech and no Build (build gate moot/safe, owner). FLAG #430 + the deferred outcome/instance-lifecycle system. LOCKED (owner 2026-06-16): setImprovementType stays a SEPARATE NON-CHECKING ACTOR — the direct placement path deliberately does not consult requires.build; this preserves all existing behaviour (raze->ruins, found->city) and breaks nothing. The cascade gate is the build/canHaveImprovement/event layer ABOVE it. USAGE CONVENTION (owner 2026-06-16): setImprovementType is the unconditional DOER; the CHECK (canHaveImprovement -> requires.build) is the CALLER's responsibility, run BEFORE setImprovementType in the NORMAL path (events + worker builds: check-then-set, so they respect requires.build). Calling setImprovementType DIRECTLY without a prior check is the sanctioned exception for engine outcomes that must always place (raze->ruins, found->city). So the gate lives in the caller's check, not in the setter. FUTURE: merge check+set with an explicit skip-check flag (default checked) -> issue Stones2Stars/S2S#437 (out of #428 scope).
